thread:
elaine: Quick sync — landing copy + launch posts + webinar routing. Need short hero CTAs for Hosted / Dedicated / Private, a 1‑line benchmark callout we can use in social posts, and the inbound lead routing plan. Async ok, want drafts tomorrow EOD.

sam: I can do CTAs and 3 short social lines. Draft question — keep tone PLG/product-first for all three or shift Private/Dedicated to enterprise voice? :thinking:

nina: Product-led for Hosted. Dedicated = hybrid (product + cost/latency win). Private = enterprise + compliance (SLA / VPC / KMS). Keep Hosted hero more action-oriented.

aj: Webinar logistics: propose 30m demo + 15m benchmark walkthrough + 15m Q&A. Landing needs one primary reg CTA and a secondary "watch recording" after the event. Routing: Hosted trial signups -> marketing nurture; Dedicated interest form -> AE; Private contact -> enterprise SDR. I can map to HubSpot.

sam: draft CTAs (short):
- Hosted: "Get started with Redwood Hosted — free credits"
- Dedicated: "Reserve dedicated capacity — predictable latency"
- Private: "Request Private deployment & compliance info"

Also 3 social callouts (one-liners):
- "Launch: demo + benchmarks — see Hosted API latency and cost profiles."
- "Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput — demo 4/12."
- "Private deployments w/ VPC & KMS — enterprise-ready."

nina: Shorten Hosted CTA to "Start free with Hosted API". Dedicated CTA drop 'predictable' -> "Reserve dedicated capacity". Private CTA ok but swap 'Request' -> "Contact us for Private deployments".

copybot: Suggested hero variants (small snippets):
```
Hosted hero: "Start free with Hosted API — fast time-to-value for prototypes and production."
Dedicated hero: "Dedicated GPU capacity — predictable throughput and SLA-backed latency."
Private hero: "Private deployments — VPC, KMS, and on-prem options for regulated workloads."
```

sam: For the benchmark line we should avoid unapproved numbers. Proposed: "Redwood benchmarks: significant throughput and cost improvements versus typical self-hosting — see full results." Link to doc: <https://docs.redwood.ai/benchmarks/hosting-vs-dedicated>

aj: I'll implement routing rules with these mappings and add UTM tags: utm_campaign=launch_webinar, utm_source=social. HubSpot mapping: form=hosted_trial -> Lifecycle=MQL; form=dedicated_interest -> Owner=AE_team; form=private_contact -> Owner=Enterprise_SDR. I'll paste the rule snippet here when done.

elaine: Perfect. Sam — first pass CTAs + hero copy by EOD tomorrow. Nina — will you schedule webinar + speakers? Aj — please paste the HubSpot routing snippet and I’ll QA. Thanks team :rocket:
